notes:
图像翻译支持自定义语言增删持久化、视觉圆角微调与操作栏合并
1. 图像翻译支持自定义添加与删除目标/源语言：语言选择器底部新增「+ Add」按键，可自由输入任意想要翻译的语言描述（如“文言文”、“西班牙语”、“繁体中文”等），AI 智能识别，即时生效；条目右侧提供「-」按键可一键删除自定义语种，并自动平滑回退默认语言。
2. 多端交互与防遮挡深度优化：修复浏览器自动填充浮层遮挡 OK 按钮的问题，优化 IME 拼音输入与多端触控，全平台点击/触摸 OK 均能 100% 灵敏响应。
3. 语言偏好全量本地持久化：自动记忆用户最后一次选中的源语言/目标语言与自定义语种列表，重启 App 依然保留，图片 File 实例物理隔离杜绝存储污染。
4. 按键视觉圆角微调 (10px)：Take Photo、Choose Image 与语言选择器统一调整为 rounded-[10px]，窄屏下始终保留直边，与外层虚线框更和谐对称。
5. 操作栏按键归一合并：将相机与添加文件两个按键合并为统一的「+」弹出菜单，精简空间，确保操作栏在窄屏移动端 100% 完整排布。

notes_en:
Image Translation Custom Languages with Persistence, Corner Radius Tuning & Action Bar Consolidation
1. Custom Image Translation Languages: Added "+ Add" button in language selectors to input any custom target/source languages (e.g. Classical Chinese, Spanish, Traditional Chinese, etc.) with automatic AI recognition and instant activation. A "-" button allows seamless deletion of custom entries with safe fallback to defaults.
2. Cross-Platform Input & Anti-Blocking Optimization: Resolved browser autofill overlay blocking the OK button and enhanced IME/touch event handling across Web, desktop (Tauri), and mobile (Capacitor/Webview).
3. Full Local Persistence: Automatically remembers selected source/target languages and custom language lists across app restarts, with clean isolation of file instances.
4. Button Corner Radius Harmonization (10px): Tuned button border radius to rounded-[10px] for Take Photo, Choose Image, and language selectors to preserve straight vertical edges on narrow screens and match the dashed box container.
5. Action Bar Button Consolidation: Consolidated separate camera and file-add buttons into a single "+" dropdown menu, ensuring all action bar buttons fit cleanly on mobile screens.
